snippet.title: WEX: 5v5 FPS Alpha Launch | Download Now
snippet.description:
WEX: 5v5 FPS Alpha is live now! Join our Discord server and complete the form to claim your access: https://discord.gg/ZsmJs5FJfX

5v5 tactical Nexus Defuse with heroes, abilities, and an arsenal that scales with every round. But this isn't just another tactical shooter.

Introducing the Extension Phase. Win a round as attackers and the fight isn't over. The Nexus stays planted, all defenders respawn, but only your surviving teammates hold the site. Fewer allies. Full enemy team. Pure pressure. Pull it off and your team scores an additional point in the same round, making jaw dropping comebacks possible even from the deepest deficits.

More clutch Xv5 moments. More last second defuses. More reasons to lose your mind.

Choose from a roster of unique heroes, master abilities that reshape the battlefield, and compete in a free to play experience built for esports from the ground up.
